notes: A 30 in. under-cabinet stainless steel hood with push-button controls and back LED lights. The guide also covers the COS-5MU36, and the COS-5MU30-BK is the matte black variant; for ductless use the carbon filter is bought separately.

gaps: Power: the guide gives 125 W motor input power; the 5MU30 spec sheet gives 141.5 W wattage for the hood (the -BK sheet gives the same). 125 W is on the motor only.
Light: the spec sheet lists back 3 W LED; the guide says to fit an E26 bulb of 40 W maximum (and calls the lamps LED lamps). Both kept, each as its own document says.
The guide's 110-120 V AC 60 Hz and the sheet's 120 V / 60 Hz are for the hood, so v is not put on the motor.
The parts diagram heading is unreadable (garbled in the text layer and the render); the guide's title and Fig. 2 name both the 5MU30 and 5MU36, so the diagram is taken as theirs.
The guide says charcoal filters come only with ductless models, yet the diagram marks the carbon filter not included; treated as a separate purchase.
No part numbers were found for the motor, fan or control board.
method: Cosmo COS-5MU30 / 5MU36 install and user guide, Rev. 23.03, on cosmoappliances.com (linked from the COS-5MU30 product page): PDF pages 3, 4 (parts diagram rendered), 6, 7 and 8. Each PDF page holds two printed pages.
Lowe's-hosted copy of the same guide, Rev. 24.07, read as text; the parts, ratings and bulb lines match, it adds only the words stainless steel models only.
Cosmo COS-5MU30 specification sheet (Jan 2023) on cosmoappliances.com, page 1.
Cosmo COS-5MU30-BK specification sheet (Lowe's-hosted), page 1, for the matte black finish.
The 5U30 product page and 5U series documents are a different model line and were not used.

comps.spec: Motor input power 125 W (the same page lists the hood at 110-120 V AC, 60 Hz). Troubleshooting says to replace the motor assembly when the motor no longer runs.
Fan; troubleshooting says to realign or replace it if it is broken or out of balance.
Aluminum filters (parts diagram item 3), called grease filters elsewhere in the guide. Hand wash only, not in the dishwasher; the guide recommends replacing them every 6 months depending on use.

Carbon (charcoal) filter for recirculating use, not included and bought separately (parts diagram item 4). Installed at the end of the motor and twisted clockwise to lock; it can't be washed and the guide says to replace it every 4 to 6 months depending on use.
comps.loc: At the end of the motor

comps.spec: Light bulb, E26 type, 40 W maximum (bulb replacement steps and troubleshooting).
Push-button control panel: power indicator light, light button, motor off, and low, medium and high speed buttons.
Hood body in 430-grade stainless steel (spec sheet).
Control panel or circuit board; troubleshooting says to replace it when the motor no longer runs.
